description: This file defines a REST controller named RootController that provides minimal health check endpoints to verify the application's liveness and readiness status. It is part of a Spring Boot backend application, designed to run in stub/no-database mode for frontend integration testing.

classes.name: RootController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing health check endpoints to confirm backend availability.

methods.name: root
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a message indicating the backend is running.

methods.name: healthz
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/healthz' and returns a simple OK status for liveness check.
